scope: Bounded source-grounded single-mechanism audit and independently launched repeated browser captures. No model fitting, tuning or synthetic CSS changes.
word_policy: FROZEN. No editing, overwriting, copying as a new version, or invoking taskbook writers without explicit user request.

word_reference.archive_path: protocol/网页截图的细微变更分类｜实验任务书_v1.1.docx

positive_candidates.grouping: All browser/direction snapshots of one commit are one change unit and one project; not6 independent edits.
positive_candidates.category_rule: Source and pixel review may support narrowed color/contrast mechanism. No automatic atomic13 gold label; multi-property or test-environment changes retained as limitations.

reviewed_but_not_assumed_positive: Ionic checkbox alignment commit adds new test screenshots, without matched parent PNGs.
Ionic round-button commit changes size, icon font, padding and capture region; mixed not pure rounded.
MDN display:grid addition may be redundant with existing media class; render before claiming any visible layout change.

replay.browser: Existing installed Google Chrome via bundled Playwright
replay.animations: Browser screenshot animations disabled; no injected CSS or DOM mutation
replay.independence: Fresh browser process, fresh context and load for every counted capture; PNG not reused. Two captures per fixed artifact.

local_mdn.policy: Serve verified original files locally without HTML/CSS edits. Block external network. MDN documentation example is not production-site evidence.

ionic_archive.artifact_policy: One bounded public-page acquisition to HAR per page, then2 separately launched browsers replay the same archived bytes offline. Seed acquisition is not a repeat control.
ionic_archive.historical_commit_relation: Live alias may not expose exact Git commit. Record content hash/version evidence; do not claim these controls reproduce2024 snapshots.
ionic_archive.failure_policy: Record failed acquisition/replay or missing resources and exclude from valid controls, do not hide failures.

pixel_rule: Original RGB shapes; compare exact and>4 differences using run07 audit helper; do not resize or choose thresholds. Same-version repeat stability is descriptive, not population FPR.
excluded: All419 opened confirmation examples and historical155/355/72 controls; no training/threshold changes.
export_policy: Only scripts/config/source pointers/hashes/filtered decisions; no images, upstream source files, HAR, raw logs, models or credentials
